messages.subject: Hessian and marginal likelihood for random effects with tmbstan
messages.subject_clean: Hessian and marginal likelihood for random effects with tmbstan
messages.body_plain:
I'm working with a spatio-temporal model (including a GMRF for spatial effect) to do the inference with tmbstan (a bayesian model).
How can I obtain the marginal likelihood with Laplace approximations for each random effect and the Hessian after of the optimize?

I hope that you can help me
Thanks!!

messages.subject: Different values returned by REPORT vs ADREPORT
messages.subject_clean: Different values returned by REPORT vs ADREPORT
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,
I've been looking around on the users group and on the wiki but can't find any information on this issue. Apologies if it has been raised before.

I've found a weird quirk when examining the results of an integrated fisheries model built in TMB. If I return values from the TMB model using REPORT() as well as ADREPORT() the values differ by a very small percentage. In most instances this is very inconsequential but when returning estimates of large numbers such as absolute biomass the differences can become important. I also noticed that these differences get larger as the model timestep increases. Here is the printout of the same quantity from the TMB model using ADREPORT vs REPORT along with the differences:

     Year      ADREPORT    REPORT    difference

1  1992      693137.3     693137.3  -0.002377396

2  1993      655004.1     655004.1  -0.007568417

3  1994      539209.3     539209.3  -0.017372600

8  1999      261407.5     261407.5  -0.029505266

10 2001     352431.1     352431.2  -0.041130742

22 2013     505431.4     505431.7  -0.209379682

23 2014     529863.0     529863.2  -0.223596698

24 2015     535416.3     535416.6  -0.252537640

25 2016     530757.3     530684.5  72.801445017

26 2017     525671.9     525508.7 163.248326852

27 2018     526381.3     526202.1 179.178333450

28 2019     531474.3     531308.0 166.266958285

Any ideas on why this is happening or any advice on how to handle it? My assumption would be the trust the ADREPORT values, especially as I want to present to variance with these quantities. Hopefully this is a simple oversight on my part that is easily fixed.

Any insight or help would be appreciated.

Jon

messages.subject: Re: Different values returned by REPORT vs ADREPORT
messages.subject_clean: Different values returned by REPORT vs ADREPORT
messages.body_plain:
For anyone who comes across the same issue later on - the answer was that I wasn't explicitly calling the reported values using the best fitting parameters. My call to obj$report() should actually have been obj$report(obj$env$last.par.best).
Thanks to Jim Thorson for his assistance.
Jon
